dach.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space with parameters $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, a kernel $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, functions $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and sets $F, G \subseteq X$ satisfying the standing assumptions `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G`, and suppose $X$ carries a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$. For a set of tiles $\mathfrak{A} \subseteq \mathfrak{P}(X)$, a tile $p \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$ and a function $g : X \to \mathbb{C}$, `dach 𝔄 p g` is an extended nonnegative real number in $[0,\infty]$; according to its docstring, it is the quantity $h(p)$ in the proof of Lemma 6.1.4.
